pr_title: *: add binary plan in stmt summary and slow log/query
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?


Issue Number:  close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/35889


### What is changed and how it works?

- Add a field into `stmtCtx` to cache the binary plan.
- Add a field into the `SlowQueryLogItems` that contains the binary plan.
- Output the binary plan to the slow log in the format of `Binary_plan: tidb_decode_binary_plan('xxx')`
- Add a field into the `stmtSummaryByDigestElement` that contains the binary plan.
- Add a column into "statements_summary" and "slow_query" to output the binary plan.
- Add a global system variable to control if we should generate the binary plan for the execution of a statement.

issue_context.title: Make tidb generate binary plan to support the visual plan feature
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

The dashboard is implementing a feature to display the execution plan visually instead of a string.
This needs tidb to output the execution plan more structurally.

We add a new message to transmit the execution plan in protobuf: https://github.com/pingcap/tipb/pull/265
And we plan to add a new field to output it in the slow query/slow log and the statements summary.

Design of the changes at tidb side (in Chinese): https://docs.google.com/document/d/14PyiK1rEZ4OjCpmWSW-9l0wHlYeL9EA0vaPdtWVl44g/edit

review_comments: it's a instance scope or cluster scope?

It's cluster scope.
It's controlled by the global scope system variable. Once the system variable is updated, the `GenerateBinaryPlan` will be updated in all tidb.
